P1_vf4_single_arm.name: P1 VF-4: chamber frame blank (version B) from the deck into the vise and out

segments.note: home -> above the part on the deck
down 120 mm onto the end wall
close on the 28 mm wall
lift 150 mm off the deck
carry through the door to 120 mm above the vise
lower 120 mm into the open vise
pneumatic vise closes (machine M-code); gripper opens
retreat 120 mm up
out of the machine to home

P2_lathe.name: P2 lathe: 2-1/8 in. 6061 slug from the deck into the chuck

segments.note: home -> 100 mm above the slug (deck)
down 100 mm round the slug's top (deck)
close on Ø54
lift 130 mm off the deck
carry the slug to the front of the door, level with the spindle axis
straight in 450 mm through the door onto the spindle axis
push 70 mm along the spindle axis into the open jaws
chuck closes (foot pedal / M-code); gripper opens
up 100 mm off the slug
straight back 450 mm out of the door
out of the lathe to home
